title: Cartan Equation Solution — Spin-Torsion Coupling
plaintext:
EINSTEIN-CARTAN TORSION SOLUTION
================================

  T¹₁₂ = 1.014802    T¹₁₃ = 0.000134    T²₂₃ = -0.000024

|T| = 2.0042e+0 m⁻¹
λ (coupling) = -9.9300
σ (spin density) = -2.0040e-3 J·s/m³
